description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order to impose a Special Commodity Levy on Mackerel valid for a period of 06 months commencing from 18.09.2015
reasoning: This gazette content imposes a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007.
